desc: Please find attached herewith outcome of the Board meeting held on September 01, 2026, with respect to acquisition of 100% equity stake in Vishwakarma Realty Private Limited
Outcome of Board Meeting: Acquisition of 100% equity stake in Vishwakarma Realty Private Limited

Pursuant to Regulation 42 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, the Registrar of Members and Share Transfer Books of the Company will remain closed from Wednesday, September 16, 2026 to Friday, September 18, 2026 (both days exclusive) for taking record of the Members of the Company for the purpose of Annual General Meeting.
